title: A replay that refuses every request still exits 0, so a CI step trusting the exit status passes a replay that served nothing
foundBy: session agent, while building a replayed test of the campaign viewer's agent Q&A on this host
details:
A `cs-vcr replay` that has refused every request it received still ends with exit status 0. R33 in SPEC.md requires exit 4 only for a miss, and a request refused as `unknown_cassette` or `cassette_unusable` is not counted as one.

Reproduced at `41c67be`: start `cs-vcr replay` on an empty store, POST once to `/c/anthropic/nosuch/v1/messages`, and stop it. The summary reads `requests 1`, `replayed 0`, `misses 0`, `unknown cassette 1`, `rejected 1`, and the exit status is 0.

A real test ran into the same thing. A cs-vcr built on 2026-09-10 refused two cassettes recorded at ruleset v14, each request answered "recorded by a different build", and it exited 0. A script that gated on the exit status reported a pass. The script now reads the summary and fails on `rejected` above 0 or `replayed` of 0.

The manual says replay exits 4 "if any request had no recording", which a reader takes to include these. Either the exit status or R33 and the manual should say what a refused request means for a replay.
